Only anonymous points and vectors draw. Picking returns the list for points and vectors and for named segments and lines and rays and circles and conics and arcs and sectors. A number or Boolean anywhere makes a list non-drawable. Visits at most 256 entries per list and 512 shared by desktop camera fitting and painting in one frame or 4096 per SVG or pointer query. Create List accepts the supported rectangle shapes with at most 256 objects and 16 KiB of labels. Rectangle selection and filtering share 4096 units for candidates and shape preparation and vertex reads and journal operations. Exhaustion cancels the operation. Transformed shapes allow 64 preparation levels and clipped polygons need cached contours. Import rebuilds supported saved definitions. Import omits the drop-down UI.
